meta.title: Reelix: an agent-native copilot for your film, TV and anime collection
meta.description: Self-hosted and open source. You say the title; Reelix finds it, picks a release, downloads it, files it into your Jellyfin library by hard link and fetches the subtitles.

hero.lead: An agent-native copilot for your film, TV and anime collection. It finds the title, picks a release, downloads it, files it into your library and fetches the subtitles, on your own NAS, with the tools you already run.
hero.note: Works with qBittorrent, Jackett and Jellyfin. Runs on your own NAS.

demo.label: An illustration of a real conversation
demo.user: Get me Sintel, the 2010 Blender film.
steps: Looked inside the 1080p BluRay: one film, one Chinese subtitle
Filed by hard link into Movies/Sintel (2010)
demo.overview: A young woman searches far and wide for a small dragon she once looked after.
demo.answer: Sintel is in your library, with a Chinese subtitle beside it. It keeps seeding from where it was downloaded.

loop.title: One sentence in, a filed film out
loop.lead: The whole path from a name to a title you can play, done by one agent that can see every step.

steps.name: Identify
steps.text: From anything: a name, a TMDB or Douban link, a magnet, a photo of a poster.

steps.name: Search
steps.text: Every indexer at once. Reelix looks inside a release before trusting its name.

steps.name: Download
steps.text: With qBittorrent. Why this release was chosen is written down when it is added.

steps.name: Organise
steps.text: Hard links into a Jellyfin-standard library. Nothing is copied; seeding goes on.

steps.name: Subtitle
steps.text: Found, checked against the video, cleaned and placed. Or translated when none exists.

steps.name: Follow
steps.text: A standing instruction in your own words. New episodes arrive as they air.

agent.title: The agent is the product
agent.lead: Most tools in this space are rule systems with a chat box added. Reelix is the other way round.

points.title: It works on the real system
points.text: The agent has a shell and file access inside its container. It can look at a messy download and fix it, without anyone having written a tool for that case.

points.title: Judgement, not rule tables
points.text: Reading an odd release name or choosing between releases goes to the model, guided by a plain note of your taste. Exact code stays where a mistake costs something.

points.title: It asks only on a real tie
points.text: And remembers the answer. Questions, plans and notices wait in one Inbox, on the web, as a push notification or in Telegram.

features.title: Everything around the film, too
features.lead: Finding and filing is the core. These come with it.

items.title: Chat from anywhere
items.text: On the web, in the terminal and in Telegram. The same agent, with the same note of your taste.

items.title: Subtitles in any language
items.text: When none exists, Reelix translates one with your own models into a separate file. The video is never touched.

items.title: Trends and suggestions
items.text: What is trending, the anime airing now, and picks based on what you watched in Jellyfin.

items.title: An Inbox that reaches you
items.text: Questions and plans arrive as a notification on your phone or in Telegram. Answer from wherever you are.

items.title: Adopts what you already have
items.text: Existing downloads are scanned and filed into the library, once you approve the plan.

items.title: Yours to shape
items.text: Two themes and your own, four languages, and any model provider you like.

plugins.title: Built to be extended
plugins.lead: Almost everything that talks to an outside service is a plugin. Switch them on and off in Settings, install new ones, or ask Reelix to write one for you.
plugins.hooksText: Change a decision as it is made.
plugins.moreText: Operations with a declared effect, a screen in the web UI, a pack of skills for the agent.

safety.title: Soft limits, hard invariants
safety.lead: In conversation the agent does what you ask. A few things are fixed in code, because they are about correctness and cost, not permission.

items.title: A yes is used once
items.text: Destructive actions need your approval. An approval is tied to the exact request and cannot be replayed.

items.title: Outside text is data
items.text: Release names, web pages and subtitle contents are marked as outside text and never treated as instructions.

items.title: Everything is written down
items.text: Every operation, whoever ran it, leaves one record in the ledger: what, by whom, with what result.

items.title: Removal can be undone
items.text: Removing a title removes a link. A last remaining copy goes to a trash that is kept for 14 days.

items.title: Secrets stay out of chat
items.text: Keys and passwords are typed into a secret field. They never reach the model or a saved conversation.

items.title: Spending has a cap
items.text: Background work stops at a daily limit you set, and each plugin that uses your models has a budget of its own.

works.title: Works with what you already run

start.title: Get started
start.lead: Reelix runs in one container beside your existing services. A pre-flight script checks your NAS first.

comments.preflight: finds your services, tests hard links, prints a .env
comments.env: then put in what the pre-flight printed
comments.pi: sign in to a model provider
comments.serve: the first visit sets the password

start.status: Reelix is pre-release software. It has not yet had a long run on a NAS, and the plugin API is still version 0. Expect changes.

footer.tagline: An agent-native copilot for your film, TV and anime collection.
